blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The provincial government of Ilocos Norte and the Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority (TIEZA) will rehabilitate the Paoay Golf Course. The plan is to restore it as a public-access recreational destination and boost local tourism. In a statement on Saturday, Gov. Cecilia Araneta-Marcos said she and TIEZA Chief Operating Officer Mark Lapid inspected the golf course for the improvements. Designed by golf legend Gary Player, the Paoay Golf Course features an original 18-hole layout and is among the province’s recreational attractions.
